name: Tying cloth tightly around the abdomen after birth
what_people_do: Tie a wrapper or cloth tight across the belly after delivery, for days or weeks.
why_they_say_it_works: To "close" the body, flatten the stomach and support the womb.

documented_by.source: Udigwe GO, Emelumadu OF, Udigwe IB 2013, West Afr J Med, PMID 24488282
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Nnewi, 330 mothers: 66.1% tied cloth across the abdomen after delivery.

evidence.population: Meta-analysis of 4 RCTs, 601 women (not vaginal births, not Black women specifically)
evidence.finding: No difference in pain score at 24 or 48 hours; significantly less post-operative distress.

source.name: Abdominal binders after caesarean, meta-analysis of 4 RCTs, 2021, PMID 33993065

harm_note: Evidence is for caesarean recovery only. Very tight binding after vaginal birth has no source I opened for or against.
gaps: No trial of binding after vaginal birth read.
Diastasis recti rehabilitation systematic review (PMID 41224804) seen as a title only.
